issues.issue: The retirement GC as designed (delete every published SHARD_FILE not in the live set of current+predecessor, triggered from publish, startup AND from an `onFullyReleased` hook that fires on whatever query thread closes the last lease) will delete the outputs of an in-progress build. Both builders write their shards under the FINAL published name during the build, long before the manifest is published: FrontierStatisticsBuilder.java:436-446 (`fileName = "generation-%019d-shard-%05d.fs2s"`, `moveAtomically(temporary, target)` per shard), FrontierOmniDeltaBuilder.java:109-120 and FrontierStatisticsDeltaBuilder.java (~lines 100-160, three `moveAtomically` calls). A base rebuild runs for minutes in LmdbSailStore.rebuildFrontierStatisticsV2 (:1385-1391) outside `LmdbStatisticsService.publish`'s monitor; any lease release during that window (FrontierStatisticsGeneration.release :283-291 -> hook -> collectGarbage) computes the live set from the CURRENT manifest, finds the new generation's files unreferenced and deletes them, so `publish` then fails with 'shard is missing' (FrontierStatisticsGeneration.open :104-106) and the rebuild loops. The startup sweep has the same effect on completed-but-unpublished generations (several FrontierStatisticsBuilderTest cases build gen N+1 into the directory before publishing).
issues.suggestion: Never delete a manifest or shard whose filename generation id is >= the current generation id: both builders always allocate ids strictly greater than the current one (FrontierStatisticsDeltaBuilder.nextGeneration = max(previous+1, coveredEpoch); LmdbSailStore:1380-1382 generation = max(snapshotEpoch, previous+1)). Additionally run collectGarbage only under the service monitor from publish()/rollback()/startup and have the release hook merely schedule it on estimatorPersistExec (not on the planner thread). Add a test: hold a lease on gen1, start a delta/base build (shards on disk, unpublished), release the lease, then publish -> must succeed.

issues.issue: Selection rules (4)/(5) key on `sharedWitnesses`, but that signal is degenerate for bridges: `SingleLaneEstimate.EXACT_ZERO` carries witnesses 0 (FrontierOmniIndex.java:1889) and the bridge folds `laneWitnesses = min(laneWitnesses, degree.witnesses())` (:863, :876; composite :757). So any lane in which ONE sampled key has zero degree on the probed side ends with sharedWitnesses 0 -> `isWeak` (FrontierSamplingQuality.java:99-105, MINIMUM_STRONG_WITNESSES=8) and confidence 0 (:87-89). In the hidden-hub repro the REVERSE orientation samples p8 subjects, most of which are singletons with zero p7-object degree, so the reverse 164,860 estimate is also 'weak with zero witnesses'. Rule (5) as written ('both weak with zero witnesses -> CONFIDENCE_TOO_WIDE') therefore returns unavailable (pointRows 1.0, FrontierJoinEstimate.java:30-33) and the ported repro `hiddenHubBridgeIsNotEstimatedAsEmpty` (asserts point >= exact/16) fails; rules (3)/(4) cannot separate quality either because both sides read as 0 witnesses / 0 confidence.
issues.suggestion: Define (5) as 'both non-exact AND both pointRows == 0' (typed unknown only when neither orientation saw any match), and let a positive weak point beat a zero weak point unconditionally. Separately fix witness accounting so an exact-zero degree does not zero the lane (count matched sampled rows / positive-degree keys as witnesses); otherwise 'strong beats weak' is inert for real data. Add the mirrored-hub test the design lists and a true-empty-join test (`:a :p :x . :b :q :y` with `?s :p ?o . ?o :q ?z`) asserting the outcome you intend (typed unknown vs exact zero).

issues.issue: Part (5) (return `legacyPackedRows` instead of NaN from LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.packedStatementPatternRows on Frontier fallback) is not needed for the 1-row fix and widens a known defect. Its only consumer is the finite-probe path: LmdbPackedCostModel.finiteProbeRows (:3592-3600) called from :3516, where NaN currently yields `return null` (:3517, no finite lookup). With a finite value the result is stamped `finite_binding_probe` + `EvidenceGuarantee.DATABASE_EXACT` (:386-388) although `planningCardinality` is the bounded page estimate (TripleStore.java:1801-1803 -> cardinality :1754-1799, residual matcher sampling) that can return an inexact 0. That is exactly REVIEW 3.10 'Sampled planning cardinalities labelled DATABASE_EXACT', which today is reachable only in OFF mode; (5) makes it reachable in every AUTHORITATIVE cold/stale window. Consumers of the false exactness: PackedCascadesPlanner.java:723 (root rows certified from the exact evidence), PackedJoinEnumerator.java:10715-10721 (exactness propagated to joins), LmdbPackedCostModel.java:1420 (mapped refinement skipped), LEO exclusion of misestimates. The legacy 1-row route is already fixed by part (2): legacyEstimateRows (:233-238) goes through runtime.conventionalStatementPatternRows -> evidence source.
issues.suggestion: Drop (5), or return legacy rows only together with an exactness flag and stamp MEASURE_UNBIASED (not DATABASE_EXACT) unless the source reported `exact()` (LmdbPageCardinalityEstimator.CardinalityEstimate.exact at TripleStore:1877-1880 is the only exact case). Keep LmdbEstimatorStorageAccessV2Test asserting NaN->no finite lookup for fallback until the 3.10 fix lands.

issues.issue: The fix only touches LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence, but two other mode-blind gates keep SHADOW (and Frontier-unavailable AUTHORITATIVE) planning different from OFF: (a) LmdbEstimatorRuntime.java:494 passes `statistics != null && frontierSettings.mode() != OFF` as `mappedStatisticsOwnPlanning` to LmdbFilterPassSelection.mappedOrBestAvailable (:53-62), which then returns only the mapped fallback or UNKNOWN and suppresses snapshot/learned/sampled filter evidence -> SHADOW changes filter-pass planning. (b) LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.java:159 `statistics == null && cardinalities != null` suppresses the LMDB distinct cursor-skip probe whenever a service exists, so SHADOW and cold AUTHORITATIVE lose cursor-skip costing that OFF has. Also the severity is understated: in SHADOW the packed planner routes leaves through LmdbPackedCostModel.legacyEstimateRows :233 (`runtime.statisticsService() != null`) -> conventionalStatementPatternRows -> evidence source, which today returns [] in SHADOW -> heuristic 1.0, i.e. SHADOW packed leaves are 1-row right now; LmdbEstimatorStorageAccessV2Test#shadowPackedLeafObservesMappedStatisticsWithoutChangingTheLegacyEstimate tests packedStatementPatternRows, which is NOT the entry point the cost model uses when a service exists.
issues.suggestion: Route both gates through the same `authoritative()`/frontierAnswered predicate (AUTHORITATIVE for :494; `!frontierAnswered` for :159). Add a test through LmdbPackedCostModel.estimateRows in SHADOW asserting the storage rows, and a SHADOW filter-pass test through LmdbEstimatorRuntime.estimateFilter asserting equality with OFF.

issues.issue: The per-estimate budget cannot be enforced soundly in the production steady state: `progressive = deltaIndex.isEmpty() && maximumCandidateRows < candidateSlice.count` (FrontierOmniIndex.java:1093) so prefix sampling with a correct inclusion probability exists only while no Omni delta layer is mapped; `deltaIndex` is non-empty after the first delta publication (:121, :156) until the next base rebuild. Truncating a non-progressive scan at the budget would return a biased (systematically low) point. The design says 'fall back to the budget cap only' without defining the result. Also the entry-point placement is ambiguous: estimateBridge/estimateCompositeBridge call `estimateLeaf` internally (:781-782, :899-901) for productBound, so a `beginEstimate` inside `estimateLeaf` would reset the shared budget mid-estimate; `Scratch` is per-lease (FrontierStatisticsLease.java:19) and one lease serves a whole packed session (LmdbPackedCostModel :156-166), so `candidateRowsVisited` accumulates across estimates today.
issues.suggestion: Specify: on budget exhaustion in a non-progressive scan return LaneEstimate.UNAVAILABLE (typed CONFIDENCE_TOO_WIDE upstream), never a truncated point; make CellSlice.restrictPrefixSampling delta-aware or apply delta layers post-hoc so progressive scanning also works with deltas; put beginEstimate at FrontierMappedStatistics/Generation entry points with a nesting-depth guard. Validate on the theme harness that large-bridge estimates do not degrade into fallbacks most of the time.

issues.issue: Part (2) checks the delta-tier debt 'before building' and returns BASE_REBUILD_REQUIRED, which stops delta publication until a base rebuild is allowed to start (quiet period + `storeTxnStarted` gate at LmdbSailStore.java:1174-1177). Under sustained writes the uncovered mutations exceed MAXIMUM_IN_MEMORY_MUTATIONS=16,384 and the tail is cleared (:1303-1331 appendCurrentFrontierMutationTail), so leaves fall to CONFIDENCE_TOO_WIDE — the state the fix is meant to avoid. The repro `defaultBudgetInsertOnlyGrowthKeepsFrontierCurrent` only passes because it waits 30 s between batches (no concurrent commits), so it does not exercise this coupling; 3.6.2 silently depends on 3.6.3's deadline.
issues.suggestion: Trigger the base rebuild only AFTER a successful delta publish (mirroring the deleteDebt check at :1248), and keep publishing deltas while a base rebuild is pending as long as validateDiskBudget admits them; escalate to BASE_REBUILD_REQUIRED without publishing only when the permanent envelope exception is thrown. Add a lifecycle test with concurrent 250 ms commits during the debt-triggered rebuild asserting coveredSequence keeps advancing.

issues.issue: Part (4) gates exactCandidate on `frontierLeafAnswered(pattern)` implemented as a re-probe of `estimateLeafCurrent`, which is not cheap: it takes a heap-governor scratch lease and runs Omni lane scans (LmdbStatisticsService.java:290-320 -> lease.estimateLeaf -> estimatePlane :985-1037), so the decision tier probes Frontier twice per leaf.
issues.suggestion: Make the memoisation mandatory: compute `frontierAnswered` once in statementCandidates and stash it per (EstimateContext, pattern identity) or return it alongside the candidates so exactCandidate reuses it.

issues.issue: Appending the fallback reason to the source string (`lmdb-storage-summary/frontier-NO_GENERATION`) changes BagEstimate.source, which flows into metrics, explain output and any plan fingerprint or test that asserts `source=`; a plan built under NO_GENERATION and one under CONFIDENCE_TOO_WIDE would then differ only by source text.
issues.suggestion: Keep `lmdb-storage-summary` as the source and surface the fallback reason as a separate planned metric (e.g. `plannedFrontierFallbackReason`, which LmdbPackedCostModel already emits at :401-403 for the mapped path).

issues.issue: Re-enabling the exact tier in AUTHORITATIVE cold phases means `TripleStore.exactCardinality` (:2105-2117) runs a full scan on a FRESH committed read txn (`txnManager.doWith`), not the query's snapshot (REVIEW 3.10). No estimate-driven EmptySet rewrite exists in LMDB (the only EmptySet rewrites are LmdbBoundSimplifierOptimizer:76 boolean-constant and LmdbSetSemanticsOptimizer:239 self-difference), so this is cost-only today, but an exact 0 read from a newer snapshot still drives `LmdbEstimateClassification.databaseExact` into factor costing (LmdbEstimatorRuntime.java:258-259) and filter exactness (:482-490).
issues.suggestion: Land 3.6.1 with the exact tier still gated as designed, but make the wp8 snapshot-pinned exact read a hard prerequisite (not 'with or before'), or keep exactCandidate disabled under AUTHORITATIVE until wp8 lands and rely on STORAGE_SUMMARY + ceiling only.

issues.issue: Converting FrontierOmniDeltaBuilder's dimension mismatch (:64-69) into `FrontierStatisticsException(SHARD_CORRUPT, permanent)` surfaces 'SHARD_CORRUPT' in `lastFailure`/status for a healthy store whose heap budget merely changed, and the same reason is used by recoverInvalidGeneration paths (LmdbStatisticsService.java:741-795), which conflates diagnostics.
issues.suggestion: Use MEMORY_PRESSURE (the reason forBudgets actually shrank cellCount) or add a dedicated reason; keep `permanent=true` as the escalation signal.

issues.issue: The design runs `collectGarbage()` from the `onFullyReleased` hook 'possibly on the releasing thread'; `release()` is reached from FrontierStatisticsLease.close() on planner/query threads (FrontierStatisticsLease.java:105-109), so directory listing and file deletion land on the query latency path, and the hook fires while the service monitor is not held (publish/rollback are `synchronized`).
issues.suggestion: Have the hook only flag work and schedule GC on estimatorPersistExec; execute GC under the service monitor.

issues.issue: The guard is sound (verified: latestStoreEpoch starts at -1, LmdbStatisticsService.java:53; all triple-env write transactions are recorded: statement commits via flush :2360-2362, two-phase batches :3308 inside the same commit, and the independent ack :2581 via acknowledgeFrontierCoverage :692-700), but it also fires for the ack window after EVERY delta/base publication, so plans built in that window use STORAGE_SUMMARY while `providerVersion()` (LmdbPackedCostModel.java:182-189) does not encode Frontier readiness; cold-planned entries can be cached as if warm.
issues.suggestion: Already listed under cross-WP touchpoints; add an explicit assertion test in LmdbPlanCache/LmdbCascadesOptimizer that a plan produced with fallbackReason != NONE is not served once status is NONE (or fold the fallback reason into providerVersion).

missedFindings: SHADOW filter-pass gate: LmdbEstimatorRuntime.java:494 (`statistics != null && mode != OFF` -> LmdbFilterPassSelection.mappedOrBestAvailable :53-62) still makes SHADOW suppress snapshot/learned/sampled filter evidence; belongs to 3.6.6a.

Cursor-skip gate: LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.java:159 (`statistics == null && cardinalities != null`) suppresses the bounded LMDB distinct probe in SHADOW and in AUTHORITATIVE-unavailable phases; part of the same 'service exists != service answered' root cause as 3.6.1/3.6.6a.

3.6.6a severity understated: SHADOW packed leaves are 1-row today because LmdbPackedCostModel.legacyEstimateRows :233 routes through conventionalStatementPatternRows -> evidence source ([] in SHADOW); the existing V2 storage-access test exercises the wrong entry point.

3.6.3 secondary (mapped/scalar flip): verified that FrontierStatisticsStatus.fallbackReason ignores a complete in-memory tail (LmdbStatisticsService.status :633-641 and the assertion in LmdbStatisticsServiceTest#committedMemoryTailIsQueryableBeforeDeltaPublication), so `mappedStatisticsReady()` (LmdbPackedCostModel:407-414) flips every commit; deferring is acceptable but should be tracked as a plan-stability item with an owner.

Raw-note C9d (FrontierStatisticsGeneration.validateShard :192-206 calls `shard.close()` on a shard that may be a REUSED shared shard of the still-live previous generation) interacts with 3.6.4's shared-shard reuse and is not addressed; at minimum note it in the 3.6.4 risk section.
semanticRegressionRisks: 3.6.5 rule (5) on a genuinely empty join: data `:a :p :x . :b :q :y .`, query `SELECT * { ?s :p ?o . ?o :q ?z }` on a store large enough that the bridge samples (both orientations probe exact-zero degrees, witnesses 0): the sound weak zero is replaced by CONFIDENCE_TOO_WIDE and the packed model falls back to independence (|L|*|R|/distinct), flipping to a hash join for an empty join. Results are unchanged, but a correct optimisation is lost; decide explicitly whether both-points-zero should stay a (low-confidence) zero.

3.6.5 rule (5) as literally written breaks the hidden-hub repro itself: reverse orientation is also weak with sharedWitnesses 0 (EXACT_ZERO degrees zero the lane), so `hiddenHubBridgeIsNotEstimatedAsEmpty` would get pointRows 1.0 and fail; `SELECT * { ?s :p ?o . ?o :q ?z }` on hub-shaped data would then be costed by independence instead of ~exact.

3.6.1(5) in an AUTHORITATIVE cold window: `SELECT * { VALUES ?s { :a :b } ?s :p ?o . ?o :q ?z }` with `:a :p :o1 . :o1 :q :z1 . :b :r :x .` — finite probes now return page-estimate rows stamped DATABASE_EXACT (LmdbPackedCostModel:386-388); a sampled 0 for `:a :p ?o` certifies the root/joins as exact-empty (PackedCascadesPlanner:723, PackedJoinEnumerator:10715-10721) and excludes the misestimate from LEO. Results unchanged, plan quality and learning regress.

3.6.1(4) exact tier with a concurrent writer: query on snapshot S with `:s1 :p :o1 . :s2 :p :o2 .`, while another transaction deletes both and commits before planning finishes -> exactCandidate reads the newer committed state (TripleStore.exactCardinality :2105 uses a fresh txn) and yields exact 0 for `?s :p ?o`. No estimate-driven EmptySet rewrite exists in LMDB today, so results are correct, but the cost model treats the leaf as exact-empty; this is the wp8 prerequisite.

3.6.6b with delta layers mapped: `SELECT * { ?s :p ?o . ?o :q ?z }` on a store with >262,144 candidate rows per bridge after one delta publication — if budget exhaustion returns a truncated point instead of typed unavailability, the estimate is biased low by the (unknown) unscanned fraction, systematically under-costing hub joins.

3.6.7a guard: a query whose snapshot epoch lands in the commit->recordStoreCommit window now gets STORAGE_SUMMARY evidence instead of stale Frontier exact counts; correct by construction, but `SELECT * { ?s :p ?o . ?s :q ?x }` planned in that window may be cached (providerVersion ignores readiness) and served after Frontier is READY.
verifiedClaims: 3.6.1 root cause: LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence.statementCandidates gates STORAGE_SUMMARY on `cardinalities != null && statistics == null` (:162) and exactCandidate on `statistics != null` (:269); the SYNOPSIS candidate requires AUTHORITATIVE && fallbackReason NONE && valid point (:153-154); EstimateEvidenceResolver.resolve returns `heuristic(1.0, "no-current-evidence")` with interval [0, MAX] when no candidates (:41-42).

3.6.1 packed route: LmdbPackedCostModel.estimateRows -> mappedLeafEstimate (null when fallbackReason != NONE, :440-441) -> legacyEstimateRows -> `runtime.statisticsService() != null` -> conventionalStatementPatternRows (:233-238) -> LmdbEstimatorRuntime.estimate(pattern, Set.of(), STANDARD, exactProbePermitted=false) (:437-440) -> LmdbEstimationEngine.resolvedLeaf -> resolveForDecision (:463-466), so the exact tier is not reached on the packed legacy path and STORAGE_SUMMARY alone fixes it.

3.6.1: LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.packedStatementPatternRows returns Double.NaN in AUTHORITATIVE whenever fallbackReason != NONE or probe == null (:100-104); its only production consumer is LmdbPackedCostModel.finiteProbeRows (:3592-3600 <- :3516).

3.6.1: the page estimator is bounded and cached per dataRevision (LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.estimateIds :267-286 -> TripleStore.planningCardinality :1801-1803 -> cardinality :1754-1799); estimateForPlanning returns 0 for unresolvable constants and -1 on failure (:197-215, :217-231).

3.6.1: LmdbFrontierProbeFactory.probe returns null for unresolvable constants (UNKNOWN_ID) and invalid ids (:44, :57-58), so `probe == null` means an unknown term, matching the design's 'legacy returns exact 0' statement.

3.6.1: LmdbEstimatorArchitectureTest.MAX_IMPLEMENTATION_LINES = 700, LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence is 697 lines, ROOT_IMPLEMENTATIONS lists it, and evidenceStoresNeverPointBackToEngineOrRuntime forbids references to LmdbEstimationEngine/LmdbEstimatorRuntime from the evidence file.

3.6.6a: frontierProbe() returns a probe for any mode != OFF (:214-219); mappedStatisticsOwnPlanning() is `statistics != null && mode != OFF` (:317-319) and routes filterEvidence/finiteFilterRelation/finiteFilterDomain (:292-300, :525, :540); the existing SHADOW policy test passes `cardinalities == null` (LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidencePolicyTest:93-94) so it stays green.

3.6.2: refreshFrontierStatisticsDelta maps only CONFIDENCE_TOO_WIDE to BASE_REBUILD_REQUIRED and every other FrontierStatisticsException and IOException to RETRY (LmdbSailStore.java:1254-1263); runScheduledFrontierRebuild returns on RETRY before the base-rebuild branch (:1169-1172) and reschedules every estimatorPersistDelayMillis=1000 (:186, :1191-1199).

3.6.2: FrontierStatisticsDeltaBuilder.validateDiskBudget throws MEMORY_PRESSURE 'exceeds its persistent envelope' (:247-261); layer limit throws CONFIDENCE_TOO_WIDE (:204-206); ArithmeticException -> MEMORY_PRESSURE (:225-227); FrontierOmniDeltaBuilder.build throws plain IOException on dimension mismatch (:64-69); FrontierStatisticsBuildConfig.forDiskBudget sets delta = disk - disk/8 - disk/4 - disk/4 - 5*disk/16 = disk/16 (:78-83); forBudgets halves cellCount as the last resort (:147-152); FRONTIER_HEAP_BUDGET_BYTES = maxMemory()/4 (LmdbStoreConfig:83).

3.6.2: only two base-rebuild triggers exist in the delta path: deleteDebt >= 0.10 (:1248, FRONTIER_DELETE_REBUILD_THRESHOLD :132) and completeTransactionPrefix returning empty (:1235-1238, FRONTIER_DELTA_BATCH_MUTATIONS=16,384 :131); the base builder enforces the delta/manifest tier budget too (FrontierStatisticsBuilder.java:840-844).

3.6.3: requestFrontierRebuild sets frontierRebuildRequestedNanos on every commit (:1136-1139, called from flush :2366 and init :469); the base branch requires frontierRebuildQuietPeriodElapsed() && !storeTxnStarted (:1174-1177, :1436-1439); the finally block forces retry if the timestamp moved (:1185-1187); rebuildFrontierStatistics() throws while a write txn is active (:638).

3.6.3 secondary: mappedStatisticsReady requires status.fallbackReason()==NONE (LmdbPackedCostModel:407-414) and status() derives fallback from latestStoreSequence > coveredSequence without consulting the tail (LmdbStatisticsService:633-641); openCurrentView/openView never apply the tail (:213-252).

3.6.4: LmdbStatisticsService.publish only `old.release()`s (:84-125); FrontierStatisticsManifestStore.publish writes manifest-<gen>.fs2m and switchCurrent (:58-88); the only deleters are discardGeneration (owner==gen only, :138-168), resetOwnedArtifacts/cleanupTemporaryArtifacts (:134-136, :170-174); FrontierStatisticsDeltaCompactor deletes only files owned by the current build generation (:70-71, :91-97); delta manifests carry base descriptors re-owned to the base generation (FrontierStatisticsDeltaBuilder:192-197) so deletion must be by live-file-set, as the design says; FrontierStatisticsGeneration reuses shared shards across generations by descriptor (:113-116, :145-150) and releases on refcount 0 (:283-291, :340-352).

3.6.4: rollback() loads the direct predecessor manifest from disk (:141-162) and recoverInvalidGeneration loads invalidManifest.previousGenerationId() (:741-795), so retaining current+predecessor is the minimum safe policy.

3.6.5: FrontierOmniIndex.estimateJoin returns the forward bridge whenever fallbackReason()==NONE and evaluates the reverse only otherwise (:246-259); sampledJoinEstimate returns weak ensembles as `(point, 0, productBound, quality.confidence(), NONE)` (:1345-1350); FrontierMappedStatistics.estimateJoin returns the omni estimate when point > 0 or when centers are unavailable (:459-478, :476-478 returns the weak zero).

3.6.6b: estimateBridge/estimateCompositeBridge call scanLane with maximumCandidateRows = Integer.MAX_VALUE (:1038-1041) and up to MAXIMUM_JOIN_KEYS=4,096 keys per lane (:23) with one estimateSingleLaneDetailed per key (:1118-1135); Scratch.recordCandidateRows accumulates and candidateRowsVisited() has no callers (:1436-1444); estimatePlane is progressive from INITIAL_LEAF_PRIORITY_TIER=64 (:985-1037); MAXIMUM_PATH_WORK=262,144 (:29).

3.6.7a: acquire's staleness test is `snapshotEpoch < baseEpoch || (snapshotEpoch > coveredEpoch && (latestStoreSequence < 0 || latestStoreSequence > coveredSequence))` (:189-193); latestStoreEpoch initialises to -1 (:53) and is only raised by recordStoreCommit/recordMetadataOnlySnapshotAdvance (:526-546); flush commits (:2334 or async) before recordStoreCommit (:2360-2362); physicalSnapshotEpoch is mdb_txn_id of the triples env (TripleStore:3330-3344); the only triples-env write entry points are :3308 (two-phase batch, inside a recorded commit), :3350 (startTransaction) and the ack writer (:2581), the latter recorded via acknowledgeFrontierCoverage (:692-700). Existing LmdbStatisticsServiceTest metadata-only tests (:485-506, :772-800) never call acquire with an epoch above the recorded one, so the guard keeps them green.

3.6.7b: AGMS branch clamps lanes at 0, takes the median, and sets upper = min(productBound, 4*max(point, laneUpper)+1) with confidence 1-exp(-lanes/2) (FrontierMappedStatistics:496-524); reachable only for PREDICATE-only probes whose predicate is in every probed plane's heavy list (:481-495).

Repro tests exercise the changed code: LmdbStorageEvidenceReviewReproTest calls leafCandidates/exactCandidate directly with mocked statistics/cardinalities; LmdbFrontierLifecycleReviewReproTest drives the real LmdbSailStore scheduler via commits and reflection on awaitFrontierStatisticsCoveredSequence/statementMutationStamp; FrontierEstimationReviewReproTest builds real generations and calls service.estimateJoin(epoch, probe) with latestStoreEpoch == -1 (so the 3.6.7a guard does not interfere). All 20 'existingTestsAtRisk' method names exist in the named test classes.
